name: Standard Residual without attention VE
tagline: Ordinary additive residuals with input smear and context-projected values.
description: The Standard Residual model with its 12 token-indexed value embeddings and associated gates removed. The remaining backbone is matched to the no-VE ChordRes initialization.
paperTitle: Identity Mappings in Deep Residual Networks
mechanism: Full causal attention and ordinary Pre-Norm residual additions at each sublayer
23 layers, FFN width 6144, input smear and no attention value lookup tables
limitations: Fixed-geometry research comparison at matched random output initialization; its paired no-VE ChordRes was trained through its step-1,000 evaluation.
